description: Variant of PC3289R. This course is enhanced with the Research Experience Programme, where students attend seminars and workshops, access writing consultations, receive a grant to do independent research, and present their findings at a conference. Please note that only 4 Units can be accredited towards major or specialisation requirements in the case a student undertakes 8 Units for both PC3288A/R and PC3289A/R.
preclusion: If undertaking an Undergraduate DegreeTHENmust not have completed 1 of PC3289/PC3289A/PC3289N/PC3289NR/PC3289Q/PC3289QR/PC3289R at a grade of at least D
